recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, high-contrast portrait of a man in western attire leaning against a rough stone wall, featuring heavy, weathered slab-serif typography integrated into the mid-ground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed away from the camera to create a contemplative mood
Typography layered between the subject and the background for depth
Rough stone textures mirrored in the distressed treatment of the lettering
Dark, desaturated color palette emphasizing earth tones and shadows
coreInvariants: Weathered, distressed texture on all graphic elements
Three-tier typographic stack with varying scales

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hat brim, highlighted by a directional light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, follows the vertical line of the stone wall down to the guitar, then moves left to the large-scale typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the left side provide a canvas for the primary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and beige in the stone wall and skin highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted olive green for the secondary subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between highlights and deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed slab serif with industrial proportions.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Heavy distressing applied to edges to simulate worn paint on wood or stone
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same typeface family or similar slab-serif styles.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and blocky structure.
Traditional western aesthetic with strong legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A moody, low-key photograph of a man in a black cowboy hat and dark button-down shirt, leaning against a rough, sun-dappled stone wall inside a dimly lit barn or cellar. He is looking away from the camera. A guitar is visible in the lower left. The left side of the frame is in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of text on the left. Top and bottom lines should be large, condensed slab-serif in a weathered tan color. The middle line should be smaller, wider-tracked slab-serif in a muted olive green. Apply a grit texture to the tan text and tuck the right edge of the text slightly behind the man's arm.

verificationChecks: Text appears weathered and integrated into the scene
Lighting on the subject is directional and dramatic

adjustableVariables: Amount of vignetting in the corners
Specific shade of the accent green
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Brand logos on the guitar headstock
Specific facial features of the subject

avoid: Perfectly clean vector edges on text

postGenerationChecks: Is the text legible despite the distressing?
Does the subject look naturally integrated with the stone wall?
Is the lighting consistent across the subject and the background?
Does the composition feel weighted correctly with the text on the left?
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key western portrait + heavy distressed slab-serif + earth-tone palette + textural integration.
